reason: WhaleKit is primarily an agent orchestration framework for DeepSeek Harness, providing composable skills for user-selected task routing, planning, execution, review, testing, debugging, and subagent delegation, with local symlink installation and Git-based artifact traceability.

summaries.zh: WhaleKit 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体编排技能框架，通过可组合技能支持分级任务路由、规划执行、审查测试、调试和子智能体协作。
summaries.en: WhaleKit is an agent orchestration skill framework for DeepSeek Harness that provides composable workflows for tiered task routing, planning, execution, review, testing, debugging, and subagent collaboration.

capabilities: Installs and removes local skill symlinks under the DSH home or project directory
Routes agent tasks through five user-selected process tiers
Provides planning, execution, review, testing, debugging, and subagent-dispatch skills
Uses Git commits as a traceability mechanism for artifacts and amendments
